title: Sound R1CS Gadget Optimization
summary: Prove the same BN254 R1CS statements with fewer constraints, with every optimized gadget's exported matrices checked against the intended witness relation by an exact-algebra checker, against pinned arkworks baselines.

credit.policy: Credit named contributions and independent reviews in CONTRIBUTORS.md; cite upstream sources. No automatic authorship claims.

review.note: Maintainer: @Mister-Meeseeks, from 2026-10-21. Results are author-checked; independent review of the relation checker (scripts/verify.py) and of each new candidate's relation check, and comparisons against tuned baselines, are wanted before acceptance.

requirements.note: Python 3.9+ for saved-artifact verification; Rust/Cargo for full synthesis and Groth16 replay. No GPU. Initial build needs network.
